responsibility: Implements the low-level input side for LTO sections. It defines the canonical LTO section-name table, installs reader hooks supplied by the LTO front end, fetches raw section contents from object files, transparently decompresses them when needed, provides helpers for creating simple input blocks for IPA summaries, and frees section storage through the front-end callbacks. It also owns import-side support data such as declaration-renaming tables, in-decl-state allocation and lookup for functions, and common diagnostics for malformed or overrun bytecode streams.
